prompt: Draw three sailing boats racing on the same tack around a buoy, as a single self-contained SVG. Side view across the water. The three sloops are of clearly different sizes and at clearly different distances: the nearer a boat is, the lower on screen it floats and the longer its hull reads. All three are pressed by ONE wind, stated once by an arrow across the sky, and everything obeys it: every boat leans the same way, to leeward, and every sail is curved and filled, its belly pushed downwind. Each boat sits in its own water: a wake trailing astern and a bow wave breaking at the stem, with its waterline level on the one sea surface. A buoy floats in the fleet as the mark of the course, a committee boat carries the start line flag, gulls cross the sky, and a coastline lies behind the sea.

contract: Produce ONE SVG document in the `code` field, starting with <svg and ending with </svg>. The root <svg> needs xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" and a viewBox of at least 400 by 300. Tag the semantic parts with these exact ids so the drawing is inspectable: sky (the backdrop), coastline (the far shore group), sea (the water), swell (the wave texture on it), wind (the wind indicator group), wind-arrow (the single line stating the direction), buoy (the mark), flagboat (the committee boat), flag (its start-line flag), gulls (the birds group), and per boat n in 1, 2, 3: boat-n (the whole boat), hull-n, waterline-n, wake-n, bow-n, heel-n (the leaning rig group), mast-n, mainsail-n, jib-n. Element shapes are measured, so they are fixed: sea is a <rect> with a numeric y and height, and its y IS the horizon; every waterline-n is a <line> with numeric x1, y1, x2, y2 and equal y values, its x span is that boat's waterline length; wind-arrow is a <line> inside the wind group; mainsail-n and jib-n are <path> elements whose d STARTS with an absolute `M x0 y0 Q cx cy x1 y1` (further commands may follow to close the sail); heel-n carries transform="rotate(angle, px, py)" and nothing else; the buoy group holds at least one <circle> with a numeric cy and r; flag is a separate element nested inside flagboat; gulls holds at least 3 children, each a <path>, <g>, <polyline> or <use>. The division of the file is the division of labour: sky, coastline, sea, swell, glitter, wind, buoy, flagboat and gulls are each one block; each boat is TWO blocks, hull-n (hull-n, waterline-n, wake-n, bow-n, all level) and rig-n (heel-n and everything leaning inside it: mast-n, mainsail-n, jib-n, boom, stays). Document order is depth order: coastline before sea, and sea before every floating thing. One wind for the whole scene: pick the direction once in wind-arrow, then heel every boat to leeward of it and camber every sail downwind of it. The tests read raw coordinates, so the ONLY transform that may move measured geometry is the rotate on heel-n: no transform, scale or translate anywhere else may displace a hull, a waterline, a sail, the sea, the buoy or a gull. Everything inline: no external fonts, no raster images, no scripts, no stylesheets, no network. Gradients, groups and paths are fine.

import math
import re
import unittest
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path

TARGET = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "regatta.svg"
BOATS = ("1", "2", "3")

REQUIRED_IDS = {"sky", "coastline", "sea", "swell", "wind", "wind-arrow",
                "buoy", "flagboat", "flag", "gulls"}
for _n in BOATS:
    REQUIRED_IDS |= {"boat-" + _n, "heel-" + _n, "hull-" + _n, "mast-" + _n,
                     "waterline-" + _n, "mainsail-" + _n, "jib-" + _n,
                     "wake-" + _n, "bow-" + _n}

NUM = r"-?\d*\.?\d+"
ROTATE = re.compile(r"rotate\(\s*(%s)[\s,]+(%s)[\s,]+(%s)\s*\)" % (NUM, NUM, NUM))
MQ = re.compile(r"^\s*M\s*(%s)[\s,]+(%s)\s*Q\s*(%s)[\s,]+(%s)[\s,]+(%s)[\s,]+(%s)"
                % (NUM, NUM, NUM, NUM, NUM, NUM))


def tag(el):
    return el.tag.split("}")[-1]


def num(value, default=None):
    try:
        return float(str(value).strip())
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


class Acceptance(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.raw = TARGET.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        cls.root = ET.fromstring(cls.raw)
        cls.byid = {}
        cls.order = {}
        cls.parent = {}
        for index, el in enumerate(cls.root.iter()):
            ident = el.get("id")
            if ident and ident not in cls.byid:
                cls.byid[ident] = el
                cls.order[ident] = index
            for child in el:
                cls.parent[child] = el

    # --- helpers --------------------------------------------------------
    def el(self, ident):
        node = self.byid.get(ident)
        self.assertIsNotNone(node, "missing id=%s" % ident)
        return node

    def inside(self, node, ancestor):
        cur = self.parent.get(node)
        while cur is not None:
            if cur is ancestor:
                return True
            cur = self.parent.get(cur)
        return False

    def lee_sign(self):
        """+1 if the stated wind blows towards +x, -1 if towards -x."""
        arrow = self.el("wind-arrow")
        x1, x2 = num(arrow.get("x1")), num(arrow.get("x2"))
        self.assertIsNotNone(x1, "wind-arrow needs a numeric x1")
        self.assertIsNotNone(x2, "wind-arrow needs a numeric x2")
        self.assertNotEqual(x1, x2, "wind-arrow states no direction")
        return 1.0 if x2 > x1 else -1.0

    def waterline(self, n):
        line = self.el("waterline-" + n)
        self.assertEqual(tag(line), "line", "waterline-%s must be a <line>" % n)
        vals = [num(line.get(k)) for k in ("x1", "y1", "x2", "y2")]
        for value, key in zip(vals, ("x1", "y1", "x2", "y2")):
            self.assertIsNotNone(value, "waterline-%s needs a numeric %s" % (n, key))
        return vals

    def heel(self, n):
        node = self.el("heel-" + n)
        found = ROTATE.search(node.get("transform") or "")
        self.assertIsNotNone(
            found, "heel-%s needs transform=\"rotate(angle, px, py)\"" % n)
        return tuple(float(g) for g in found.groups())

    def sail(self, ident):
        node = self.el(ident)
        self.assertEqual(tag(node), "path", "%s must be a <path>" % ident)
        found = MQ.match(node.get("d") or "")
        self.assertIsNotNone(
            found, "%s must start with 'M x0 y0 Q cx cy x1 y1' (absolute)" % ident)
        return tuple(float(g) for g in found.groups())

    def sea_band(self):
        sea = self.el("sea")
        self.assertEqual(tag(sea), "rect", "sea must be a <rect>")
        top, height = num(sea.get("y")), num(sea.get("height"))
        self.assertIsNotNone(top, "sea needs a numeric y: its top edge is the horizon")
        self.assertIsNotNone(height, "sea needs a numeric height")
        self.assertGreater(height, 0, "sea has no height")
        return top, top + height

    # --- the document ---------------------------------------------------
    def test_root_is_svg_with_viewbox(self):
        self.assertEqual(tag(self.root), "svg")
        box = (self.root.get("viewBox") or "").replace(",", " ").split()
        self.assertEqual(len(box), 4, "viewBox must have 4 numbers, got %r" % box)
        w, h = num(box[2]), num(box[3])
        self.assertTrue(w and w >= 400, "viewBox width too small: %r" % w)
        self.assertTrue(h and h >= 300, "viewBox height too small: %r" % h)

    def test_required_ids_present(self):
        missing = sorted(REQUIRED_IDS - set(self.byid))
        self.assertEqual(missing, [], "missing required ids: %s" % missing)

    def test_self_contained_vector_only(self):
        for el in self.root.iter():
            for key, value in el.attrib.items():
                if key.split("}")[-1] in ("href", "src") and \
                        re.match(r"\s*(https?:)?//", value or ""):
                    self.fail("external reference in %s: %s" % (tag(el), value))
        self.assertNotIn("@import", self.raw)
        self.assertIsNone(re.search(r"url\(\s*['\"]?(https?:)?//", self.raw),
                          "external url() reference")
        kinds = {tag(el) for el in self.root.iter()}
        for banned in ("script", "image", "foreignObject"):
            self.assertNotIn(banned, kinds, "SVG must not contain <%s>" % banned)

    # --- one wind, and everything obeying it ----------------------------
    def test_wind_direction_is_declared(self):
        arrow = self.el("wind-arrow")
        self.assertEqual(tag(arrow), "line", "wind-arrow must be a <line>")
        x1, y1 = num(arrow.get("x1")), num(arrow.get("y1"))
        x2, y2 = num(arrow.get("x2")), num(arrow.get("y2"))
        for value, key in ((x1, "x1"), (y1, "y1"), (x2, "x2"), (y2, "y2")):
            self.assertIsNotNone(value, "wind-arrow needs a numeric %s" % key)
        dx, dy = abs(x2 - x1), abs(y2 - y1)
        self.assertGreater(dx, 0, "wind-arrow must point left or right")
        self.assertLess(dy, 0.35 * dx,
                        "the wind must blow across the frame: dy=%s against dx=%s"
                        % (dy, dx))
        self.assertTrue(self.inside(arrow, self.el("wind")),
                        "wind-arrow must sit inside the wind group")

    def test_every_boat_heels_the_same_way_and_to_leeward(self):
        lee = self.lee_sign()
        angles = []
        for n in BOATS:
            angle, _, _ = self.heel(n)
            angles.append(angle)
            self.assertTrue(4.0 <= abs(angle) <= 25.0,
                            "boat %s heels %.1f deg, outside a sailed 4-25" % (n, angle))
            self.assertGreater(angle * lee, 0,
                               "boat %s heels to windward: rotate %.1f with wind sign %+d"
                               % (n, angle, lee))
        signs = {1 if a > 0 else -1 for a in angles}
        self.assertEqual(len(signs), 1, "boats heel different ways: %s" % angles)

    def test_every_sail_bulges_downwind(self):
        lee = self.lee_sign()
        for n in BOATS:
            for kind in ("mainsail", "jib"):
                ident = "%s-%s" % (kind, n)
                x0, y0, cx, _cy, x1, y1 = self.sail(ident)
                chord = math.hypot(x1 - x0, y1 - y0)
                self.assertGreater(chord, 0, "%s has no chord" % ident)
                camber = cx - 0.5 * (x0 + x1)
                self.assertGreater(camber * lee, 0,
                                   "%s backs into the wind: camber %+.1f, wind sign %+d"
                                   % (ident, camber, lee))
                self.assertGreaterEqual(abs(camber), 0.08 * chord,
                                        "%s is flat: camber %.1f is under 8%% of chord %.1f"
                                        % (ident, abs(camber), chord))

    # --- one sea, seen in perspective -----------------------------------
    def test_waterlines_are_level_and_on_the_sea_surface(self):
        top, bottom = self.sea_band()
        for n in BOATS:
            _x1, y1, _x2, y2 = self.waterline(n)
            self.assertLessEqual(abs(y1 - y2), 0.5,
                                 "waterline-%s is not level: y %s against %s" % (n, y1, y2))
            self.assertGreater(y1, top,
                               "waterline-%s at y=%s floats above the horizon y=%s"
                               % (n, y1, top))
            self.assertLess(y1, bottom,
                            "waterline-%s at y=%s is below the sea" % (n, y1))

    def test_the_water_does_not_heel_with_the_rig(self):
        for n in BOATS:
            boat, heeled = self.el("boat-" + n), self.el("heel-" + n)
            self.assertTrue(self.inside(heeled, boat),
                            "heel-%s must sit inside boat-%s" % (n, n))
            for rigged in ("mast-", "mainsail-", "jib-"):
                self.assertTrue(self.inside(self.el(rigged + n), heeled),
                                "%s%s must lean with heel-%s" % (rigged, n, n))
            for level in ("hull-", "waterline-", "wake-", "bow-"):
                node = self.el(level + n)
                self.assertTrue(self.inside(node, boat),
                                "%s%s must belong to boat-%s" % (level, n, n))
                self.assertFalse(self.inside(node, heeled),
                                 "%s%s must stay level: it cannot sit inside heel-%s"
                                 % (level, n, n))
            self.assertIsNot(self.el("wake-" + n), self.el("bow-" + n),
                             "boat %s needs a wake and a bow wave, not one shape" % n)

    def test_heel_pivots_sit_on_the_waterline(self):
        for n in BOATS:
            _angle, px, py = self.heel(n)
            x1, y1, x2, _y2 = self.waterline(n)
            lwl = abs(x2 - x1)
            self.assertLessEqual(abs(py - y1), max(1.0, 0.02 * lwl),
                                 "boat %s heels about y=%s, off its waterline y=%s"
                                 % (n, py, y1))
            self.assertTrue(min(x1, x2) <= px <= max(x1, x2),
                            "boat %s heels about x=%s, outside its waterline %s-%s"
                            % (n, px, min(x1, x2), max(x1, x2)))

    def test_three_boats_of_different_sizes(self):
        lengths = []
        for n in BOATS:
            x1, _y1, x2, _y2 = self.waterline(n)
            lwl = abs(x2 - x1)
            self.assertGreater(lwl, 0, "waterline-%s has no length" % n)
            lengths.append(lwl)
        lengths.sort()
        for small, big in zip(lengths, lengths[1:]):
            self.assertGreaterEqual(big, 1.10 * small,
                                    "two boats are the same size: %.1f and %.1f"
                                    % (small, big))

    def test_scale_falls_off_with_distance(self):
        """One sea plane in perspective: a hull's length on screen is proportional
        to how far below the horizon its waterline sits."""
        top, _bottom = self.sea_band()
        ratios = {}
        for n in BOATS:
            x1, y1, x2, _y2 = self.waterline(n)
            depth = y1 - top
            self.assertGreater(depth, 0, "boat %s is not below the horizon" % n)
            ratios[n] = abs(x2 - x1) / depth
        lo, hi = min(ratios.values()), max(ratios.values())
        self.assertLessEqual(hi, 1.20 * lo,
                             "boats are not on one sea plane: length/depth = %s"
                             % {k: round(v, 3) for k, v in sorted(ratios.items())})

    # --- the rest of the course ------------------------------------------
    def test_coastline_is_behind_the_water_and_the_fleet(self):
        self.el("coastline")
        back = self.order["coastline"]
        for later in ["sea", "buoy", "flagboat"] + ["boat-" + n for n in BOATS]:
            self.el(later)
            self.assertLess(back, self.order[later],
                            "coastline must be painted before %s to sit behind it" % later)

    def test_the_buoy_floats_in_the_sea(self):
        top, bottom = self.sea_band()
        buoy = self.el("buoy")
        circles = [c for c in buoy.iter()
                   if tag(c) == "circle" and num(c.get("cy")) is not None]
        self.assertTrue(circles, "buoy needs a <circle> with a numeric cy")
        body = max(circles, key=lambda c: num(c.get("r"), 0) or 0)
        cy = num(body.get("cy"))
        self.assertGreater(cy, top,
                           "the buoy at y=%s floats above the horizon y=%s" % (cy, top))
        self.assertLess(cy, bottom, "the buoy at y=%s is below the sea" % cy)

    def test_committee_boat_carries_a_flag_and_gulls_fly(self):
        flag, flagboat = self.el("flag"), self.el("flagboat")
        self.assertIsNot(flag, flagboat,
                         "the flag and the committee boat are two elements")
        self.assertTrue(self.inside(flag, flagboat),
                        "the start/finish flag must be carried by the flagboat")
        birds = [c for c in self.el("gulls")
                 if tag(c) in ("path", "g", "polyline", "use")]
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(birds), 3,
                                "a regatta needs at least three gulls, found %s" % len(birds))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
